I got tired of everyone being so secretive, so i released this finally which is a full backtesting dashboard allowing you to test your owns strategies yourself with an alpaca key.  The cost paying alpaca if you want 10k RPM if not wait for it.   Everyone is so secretive on these forums so.  Your strategies stay your strategies in your dashboard i could care less about them i dont need them or want them, but this is how i turned a 35% strategy into 75% this and forward testing.  which you will also beable to do in real time later if you wanted.

Good luck to everyone
